acceptanceCriteria: Paths inside a recognised Tasks store projection (.taskman/) are classified as non-source task state, with a stated reason, and do not make affected scope UNKNOWN unless a test reads them.
Impact freshness reports them separately rather than degrading source freshness.
Tests cover a repo with a dirty .taskman projection and a test that reads a .taskman file.
body: Found by the 2026-10-20 read-only Beamfall setup review (corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676; evidence under the session scratchpad beamfall-review/). In ~/projects/core-history (Tasks store queue:core:main), `corvint affected --base` reported 866 unknowns, 820 of them UNOWNED_DIRTY_PATH under .taskman/, and impact reported mixed freshness over 43 .taskman paths. Every repo that adopts Corvint Tasks carries a dirty projection most of the time, so affected never yields a closed selection there. Related: V1-1524 (hook deadline at ~1,270 dirty .taskman paths), V1-1766 (.taskman/policy.json basename readers).
title: affected/impact: Tasks store projection paths (.taskman/**) count as unowned dirty paths, so scope is always UNKNOWN in repos that use Corvint Tasks
